en.title: Multimodal Perception & Sensor Fusion
en.summary: Detect, track, and connect road users across heterogeneous observations—with explicit attention to sensing quality.
en.foundation: Roadside multi-LiDAR background modeling, 3D detection, and tracking form the current foundation.
en.future: Extend quality-aware perception to cameras, radar, aerial observations, and cross-view fusion, as suitable data become available.
en.question: How can heterogeneous observations be combined without hiding their differences in quality?
projects: Compare detection across sensing modalities
Evaluate trajectory robustness under occlusion
Study temporal alignment and perception quality

zh.title: 多模态交通感知与传感器融合
zh.summary: 在异构观测条件下检测、跟踪并关联交通参与者，显式关注观测质量与感知可靠性。
zh.status: 已有基础 → 多模态拓展
zh.foundation: 路侧多 LiDAR 背景建模、三维目标检测与多目标跟踪构成现有研究基础。
zh.future: 在数据条件允许的情况下，向视觉、雷达、空中观测与跨视角融合拓展。
zh.question: 如何融合异构观测，同时保留并利用它们在质量上的差异？
projects: 不同感知模态下的目标检测比较
遮挡条件下的轨迹鲁棒性评估
时空配准与感知质量测量

en.title: Transportation World Models & Scene Intelligence
en.summary: Explore scene representations that connect physical dynamics, road semantics, multi-agent interaction, and future evolution.
en.foundation: Quality-aware traffic perception provides methodological grounding; the I-WM preprint develops a research vision.
en.future: Study spatiotemporal representations, semantic scene graphs, physically consistent prediction, and counterfactual scenarios. VLA and closed-loop decisions remain potential longer-term extensions.
en.question: What should a traffic world model represent to make its predictions both useful and trustworthy?
projects: Construct a semantic traffic scene graph
Explore interaction-aware trajectory prediction
Test physical constraints in state prediction

zh.title: 交通世界模型与场景智能
zh.summary: 探索连接物理运动、道路语义、多主体交互与未来演化的交通场景表示。
zh.status: 前沿探索 / 研究愿景
zh.foundation: 质量感知的交通感知研究提供方法基础；I-WM 预印本提出研究愿景。
zh.future: 探索统一时空表示、语义场景图、物理一致的预测与反事实推演。VLA 与闭环决策保留为潜在的中长期拓展。
zh.question: 交通世界模型需要表示什么，才能让预测既有用又可信？
projects: 构建交通语义场景图
探索交互感知的轨迹预测
评估状态预测中的物理约束

en.title: Traffic Safety & Risk Intelligence
en.summary: Understand how observation error and trajectory uncertainty affect traffic conflicts, road-user interactions, and risk assessment.
en.foundation: Quality-aware trajectory analysis and multi-LiDAR vehicle conflict analysis ground this research stream.
en.future: Explore uncertainty propagation, vulnerable road-user interactions, and calibrated risk prediction. Surrogate conflict measures are not automatically equivalent to collision risk.
en.question: How does uncertainty in what we observe change the safety conclusions we draw?
projects: Test TTC/PET sensitivity to observation error
Study cyclist–vehicle interactions
Evaluate reliability under incomplete trajectories

zh.title: 交通安全与风险智能分析
zh.summary: 研究观测误差与轨迹不确定性如何影响交通冲突、主体交互及安全评估。
zh.status: 已有基础 → 可靠风险预测
zh.foundation: 质量感知的轨迹分析与多 LiDAR 车辆冲突分析构成这一方向的研究基础。
zh.future: 拓展不确定性传播、弱势道路使用者交互与风险概率校准。冲突代理指标不自动等同于真实碰撞事故风险。
zh.question: 观测中的不确定性，会如何改变我们对交通安全的判断？
projects: TTC/PET 对观测误差的敏感性分析
骑行者与车辆的交互研究
轨迹不完整条件下的可靠性评估

en.title: Intelligent Mobility & Infrastructure Optimization
en.summary: Connect transportation data to multiobjective infrastructure and system decisions, with room for emerging mobility applications.
en.foundation: Multiobjective roadway asset management and multiyear pavement maintenance planning.
en.future: Explore sensing-informed traffic management and connected mobility. Ground–air coordination is a candidate application, not an existing platform or dataset.
en.question: How can better information improve decisions across transportation systems and infrastructure?
projects: Multiobjective road asset management
Sensing-informed traffic management
Infrastructure decisions under uncertainty

zh.title: 智能交通系统与基础设施优化
zh.summary: 连接交通数据、多目标基础设施决策与系统优化，为新型交通应用保留拓展空间。
zh.status: 特色拓展 / 已有优化研究基础
zh.foundation: 多目标道路资产管理与多年期路网养护规划。
zh.future: 探索感知信息支撑的交通管理与智能网联交通。空地协同属于候选应用，不代表已有研究平台或飞行数据集。
zh.question: 更可靠的信息，如何改善交通系统与基础设施的决策？
projects: 多目标道路资产管理
感知信息支撑的交通管理
不确定条件下的基础设施决策
